{'text': '據報導，總統Donald Trump的商品王國正面臨一個他曾承諾在第二個任期首日就要解決的問題：通脹。', 'paragraph_context': "President Donald Trump's merchandise empire is reportedly suffering from the very issue he once promised to end on Day 1 of his second term: inflation."}

{'text': '以「讓美國再次偉大」（Make America Great Again）帽子為例，目前在特朗普集團網站上每頂標價55美元，而在總統政治行動委員會的官方網店則為每頂40美元。', 'paragraph_context': '"Make America Great Again" hats, for instance, are currently listed at $55 each on the Trump Organization\'s website and $40 a pop in the official online store for the president\'s political action committee.'}

{'text': '這個價格與2015年相比實在驚人，當時該網店每頂帽子的售價為25美元，《華盛頓太陽報》（前身為NOTUS）透過分析網頁時光機（Wayback Machine）的存檔資料發現這一點。', 'paragraph_context': "That's an eyebrow-raising leap from the price of the caps back in 2015, when they went for $25 apiece in the latter online store, The Washington Sun (formerly NOTUS) found in an analysis of the Wayback Machine's archives."}

{'text': '據該報導，在2021年1月6日致命攻擊事件發生的當天，該網店的售價為每頂30美元，即高出5美元。', 'paragraph_context': 'They cost $5 more (or $30 each) in the store on the day of the deadly Jan. 6, 2021 attack, per the report.'}

{'text': '如欲了解更多有關特朗普主題商品（如香水及紀念章）價格上漲的詳情，請按此處閱讀。', 'paragraph_context': 'You can read more on the rising prices of Trump-themed items — such as fragrances and medallions — here.'}

{'text': '這份有關特朗普「讓美國再次偉大」帽子的報道，正值商品銷售商表示銷情大跌之際——一名銷售商向《財富》（Fortune）雜誌表示，全國各地的店舖正在結業，自2024年以來需求「絕對下滑」——而這頂帽子正是那位以關稅及選擇性戰爭推高生活成本的總統所提倡的口號。', 'paragraph_context': 'The report on Trump\'s "Make America Great Again" hats — the slogan of a president whose tariffs and war of choice have increased the cost of living — comes as merchandise sellers say sales have taken a nosedive, with one vendor telling Fortune that stores nationwide are closing and that demand has "absolutely gone down" since 2024.'}

{'text': '一項最近的霍士新聞民調顯示，大多數已登記選民（77%）不認同特朗普處理通脹問題的手法。', 'paragraph_context': "A recent Fox News poll found that a majority of registered voters (77%) disapprove of Trump's handling of inflation."}

{'text': '喬治華盛頓大學（位於首都）政治管理學系教授Todd Belt向《華盛頓太陽報》表示，加價對總統的大多數支持者而言無關痛癢，但因負擔能力一直是選民最關注的議題，他批評這次加價是「不識時務」。', 'paragraph_context': 'Todd Belt, a professor of political management at George Washington University in the nation\'s capital, told the Sun the higher prices were irrelevant to most of the president\'s supporters but called the markup "tone-deaf" since affordability has been a top concern for voters.'}

{'text': 'Belt說：「那是想在任期結束前盡量賺取所有能賺的銷售額。」', 'paragraph_context': '"That\'s trying to get all the sales you can before you leave office," Belt said.'}

{'text': '「Donald Trump知道自己的政治生涯已進入倒數階段，他會盡可能在財務上從中獲取最大利益。」', 'paragraph_context': '"Donald Trump knows that his political career is on the clock, and he\'s going to try to get as much out of it financially as he possibly can."'}
